name: HIKARI
source: A robot Akari created to replace her sister who died. She becomes inhabited by the spirit of [url=/c50481]Hikari[/url] to have a second chance at life despite her sister Akari not realizing it. Her body was designed by [url=/c50479]Misatoko[/url] in order to look exactly like her spirit form that Akari can't see.
